subject: ParkView: request for conditional event-log retention & evidence for SIG/CAIQ audit
messages:
From: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@parkviewhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: ParkView Security <security@parkviewhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: conditional event-log retention + SIG/CAIQ evidence for upcoming audit

Hi Diego,

We're prepping for a SIG/CAIQ audit next quarter and ParkView's compliance team has asked whether Redwood can provide a temporary retention carveout for our production event streams (specifically the `interaction_event` and `access_event` topics). Our standard requirement is an additional 90 days of preservation beyond your default TTL to support forensic review and incident correlation.

Main asks:
- Can Redwood preserve the two topics for an extra 90 days for ParkView tenant IDs (tenant: parkview-prod-01)?
- If yes, what evidence can you share that proves logs were preserved and not altered (e.g., snapshot exports, S3 object manifests, signed checksums, audit trail showing retention state changes)?
- Please provide any playbook/step-by-step we can include in our SIG response explaining the preservation workflow and controls.

We may need a short mutual action plan (MVP) and a sign-off from Procurement/Legal if there's a deviation to our contract TTL. Can you confirm feasibility and an estimated ETA for evidence delivery? I attached our partially completed SIG spreadsheet — we've highlighted the questions where we need Redwood input.

Thanks,
Ethan Morris
Senior Information Security Engineer
ParkView Health

Attachments: parkview_sig_questions_v2.xlsx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@parkviewhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: conditional event-log retention + SIG/CAIQ evidence for upcoming audit

Ethan —

Thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet, appreciate the highlights. Short answer: we can implement a tenant-scoped, temporary retention extension for named topics and produce a package of evidence. High-level notes and next steps below. Looping in Neha (Security) and Marissa (Customer Success) for evidence and operational coordination.

Feasibility summary (initial):
- Preservation: We can set a tenant-level retention override for `parkview-prod-01` for the specified topics for +90 days. This will persist KV cache and raw event archives depending on the pipeline (we have different retention layers).
- Evidence: We can provide an export snapshot (tar.gz of the rollup), an S3 manifest with object keys and sizes, signed SHA256 checksums, and a change log entry showing the override (who/when).
- Controls: exports will be generated from an immutable export job that records the job id, start/end timestamps, operator account, and checksums. We will not modify the original objects.

What I need from you to scope delivery:
1) Confirm exact tenant IDs / topic names (you mentioned `parkview-prod-01`, please confirm).
2) Confirm whether the extra 90 days should be additive from today or from the message/event timestamp (we normally apply from retention window cutoff).
3) Any contractual constraints — if Procurement/Legal requires a formal amendment we should know now so we can include expected lead time.

Proposed timeline (if we get confirmations today):
- Day 0–1: Confirm scope and create MOP (method of preservation)
- Day 2–4: Run export job and internal validation (generate manifests/checksums)
- Day 5: Deliver evidence package + short playbook and pre-filled SIG answers

I'll draft a short mutual action plan once scope is confirmed. Marissa — can you own scheduling and delivery? Neha — can you confirm the form of evidence that satisfies SIG/CAIQ wording for "log preservation"?

Diego
Director, Enterprise Sales (Redwood Inference)

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@parkviewhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T22:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: conditional event-log retention + SIG/CAIQ evidence for upcoming audit

Diego / Ethan —

Agree with Diego's plan. A few specifics that will help satisfy SIG/CAIQ and CAIQ control language:

1) Evidence artifacts we can supply (recommended):
   - Export bundle (event-log-sample-202610.tar.gz) with a README describing export parameters.
   - S3 manifest CSV: object_key, size_bytes, last_modified, checksum, export_job_id.
   - Signed SHA256 checksums for each top-level export file, and a signed manifest file (we can sign with our internal key and include verification instructions).
   - Audit entry showing retention override: date, operator, ticket/reference.
   - Short preservation playbook (retention-playbook-snippet.txt) describing who can change overrides, approval steps, and rollback controls.

2) Controls mapping for SIG/CAIQ: we'll pre-fill the relevant CAIQ questions around "log retention and preservation" and point to the artifacts above. For the CAIQ narrative we recommend wording that specifies: immutable export job, checksums, signed manifest, and operator audit log.

3) For forensic defensibility: we recommend adding an HMAC of the manifest using a per-customer key if ParkView wants an additional tamper-evidence layer — requires KMS key exchange. Let us know if you need that.

4) Legal/Procurement note: If ParkView requires a contract-level change to TTL, route to sales/legal. We can proceed with a time-limited operational override (no contract change) but note that long-running manual overrides are operational risk and we'll document them.

I'll draft the pre-filled CAIQ answers and a one-page evidence index. If Ethan confirms tenant and topics today, I'll start the export job tomorrow.

Neha Kapoor
Security Controls Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: event-log-sample-202610.tar.gz, retention-playbook-snippet.txt

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@parkviewhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: conditional event-log retention + SIG/CAIQ evidence for upcoming audit

Ethan —

Thanks for confirming over chat earlier — we have `parkview-prod-01` and topics `interaction_event`, `access_event`. Plan below (MVP/MAP):

Mutual Action Plan (short):
- Day 0 (today): Confirm scope (done)
- Day 1: Neha runs export job, produces artifacts (export bundle, manifest, checksums)
- Day 2: Internal review & HMAC (optional if ParkView requests)
- Day 3: Delivery of evidence package + filled-in SIG excerpts + short playbook
- Day 4–7: ParkView review and legal sign-off (if Procurement needs amendment)

Deliverables we'll provide: `mutual-action-plan-parkview.pdf`, `event-log-sample-202610.tar.gz`, `signed-manifest.csv`, `retention-playbook-snippet.txt`, and prefilled CAIQ sheet.

Jonas — tagging Legal for awareness of the operational override and potential contract amendment if ParkView requests TTL change.

Ethan — can you confirm whether ParkView wants HMAC-signed manifests (Neha called this out) or if the standard signed SHA256 manifest is sufficient? Also confirm whether we should include operator names in the redaction-exempt manifest.

Once we have confirmation on HMAC and operator disclosure we’ll kick the export and you should have the package in 48–72 hours.

Diego
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-parkview.pdf
